texts: Queue timeout starts when a task is dequeued and starts execution, not while it is waiting in the queue.
Pause the queue then await queue.onPendingZero() to drain running tasks, ignoring queued tasks. Resume the queue after changing shared configuration.
The abort listener is saved in eventListener and removed with removeEventListener in the finally block after a job finishes.
